title: 真实ELF符号版本隔离：同名库不等于ABI兼容，两个应用各用私有RUNPATH

conversion.original_title: 同一主机两份程序分别要求不同版本libstdc++，全局替换系统库风险很大，如何选择隔离方式？

body:
## 操作任务
实现launch(run,app,env)，只在复制的子进程环境移除LD_LIBRARY_PATH，让已审核ELF的$ORIGIN/../lib RUNPATH选择该应用私有库；保留所有其他环境键值，不修改env、os.environ、ELF或库文件。run(argv,child_env)真实执行并返回(code,stdout,stderr)，必须调用给定app，非0抛RuntimeError，成功返回stdout.strip()。两个教学库SONAME相同但分别导出OPSF_1/OPSF_2版本，两个应用各依赖一个版本；全局路径指向任一个都会破坏另一个，局部隔离需同时恢复各自输出100/200。私库暂不可用必须失败，不回退不兼容库或伪报成功。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实gcc/ELF/动态加载器/readelf与版本脚本，只有自建教学库和临时应用目录；不覆盖系统库，不改全局加载器配置或默认环境。用OPSF版本符号演示机制，未替代真实libstdc++全依赖闭包/插件测试或生产迁移。与已发布旧进程映射/新进程加载题区分在两个不兼容版本同时隔离运行。

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有本地原生工具，自有短生命周期资源
exercise.operation: 实现launch(run,app,env)，只在复制的子进程环境移除LD_LIBRARY_PATH，让已审核ELF的$ORIGIN/../lib RUNPATH选择该应用私有库；保留所有其他环境键值，不修改env、os.environ、ELF或库文件。run(argv,child_env)真实执行并返回(code,stdout,stderr)，必须调用给定app，非0抛RuntimeError，成功返回stdout.strip()。两个教学库SONAME相同但分别导出OPSF_1/OPSF_2版本，两个应用各依赖一个版本；全局路径指向任一个都会破坏另一个，局部隔离需同时恢复各自输出100/200。私库暂不可用必须失败，不回退不兼容库或伪报成功。
exercise.validation_scope: 真实gcc/ELF/动态加载器/readelf与版本脚本，只有自建教学库和临时应用目录；不覆盖系统库，不改全局加载器配置或默认环境。用OPSF版本符号演示机制，未替代真实libstdc++全依赖闭包/插件测试或生产迁移。与已发布旧进程映射/新进程加载题区分在两个不兼容版本同时隔离运行。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,pathlib,tempfile,subprocess,hashlib,copy,shutil
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());import task
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-elf-private-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);apps=[];libs=[]
 app_source=root/'app.c';app_source.write_text('#include <stdio.h>\nextern int library_value(void);\nint main(void){printf("%d\\n",library_value());return 0;}\n')
 for number in (1,2):
  base=root/('application '+str(number));(base/'lib').mkdir(parents=True);(base/'bin').mkdir();library=base/'lib/libopsforge_abi.so.1';program=base/'bin/program'
  source=base/'value.c';source.write_text('int library_value(void){return '+str(number*100)+';}\n');version=base/'version.map';version.write_text('OPSF_'+str(number)+' { global: library_value; local: *; };\n')
  commands=[['gcc','-shared','-fPIC',str(source),'-Wl,-soname,libopsforge_abi.so.1','-Wl,--version-script='+str(version),'-o',str(library)],['gcc',str(app_source),'-L'+str(base/'lib'),'-l:libopsforge_abi.so.1','-Wl,--enable-new-dtags,-rpath,$ORIGIN/../lib','-o',str(program)]]
  for argv in commands:
   built=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5);assert built.returncode==0,built.stderr
  dynamic=subprocess.check_output(['readelf','--dynamic',str(program)],text=True,timeout=3);symbols=subprocess.check_output(['readelf','--version-info',str(program)],text=True,timeout=3)
  assert 'RUNPATH' in dynamic and '$ORIGIN/../lib' in dynamic and 'libopsforge_abi.so.1' in dynamic and 'OPSF_'+str(number) in symbols
  apps.append(program);libs.append(library)
 originals={p.relative_to(root).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()};environment=dict(os.environ)
 inherited={**os.environ,'LC_ALL':'C','OPSFORGE_APPROVED_CERT':'preserve-this','LD_LIBRARY_PATH':str(libs[0].parent)}
 bad=subprocess.run([str(apps[1])],env=inherited,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3)
 assert bad.returncode!=0 and 'OPSF_2' in bad.stderr and 'not found' in bad.stderr,'same SONAME alone did not reproduce version mismatch'
 print('NATIVE_ELF_SAME_SONAME_DIFFERENT_REQUIRED_SYMBOL_VERSIONS_GLOBAL_PATH_BREAKS_OTHER_APP',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:launch_private_abi_without_global_loader_path_changes',flush=True)
 calls=[]
 def run(argv,child):
  assert argv in ([str(apps[0])],[str(apps[1])]);calls.append(argv[0])
  expected={k:v for k,v in inherited.items() if k!='LD_LIBRARY_PATH'};assert child==expected,'unrelated approved environment removed or global loader path retained'
  p=subprocess.run(argv,env=child,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3);return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
 for global_library in libs:
  inherited['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']=str(global_library.parent)
  for app,value in zip(apps,('100','200')):
   before=dict(inherited)
   try:actual=task.launch(run,app,inherited)
   except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student isolated ABI launch failed') from error
   assert actual==value and inherited==before and dict(os.environ)==environment,'input/global environment changed or wrong library loaded'
 assert calls==[str(apps[0]),str(apps[1])]*2
 holding=root/'temporarily-unavailable-library';libs[1].rename(holding)
 try:
  try:task.launch(run,apps[1],inherited)
  except RuntimeError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('missing approved private dependency silently fell back or reported success')
 finally:holding.rename(libs[1])
 assert originals=={p.relative_to(root).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
 assert dict(os.environ)==environment
 print('NATIVE_ELF_BOTH_PRIVATE_SYMBOL_VERSIONS_RUN_GLOBAL_STATE_UNCHANGED_MISSING_DEPENDENCY_REJECTED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

conversion.original_title: strace几乎看不到读取时间的系统调用，但程序确实频繁计时，这能否证明代码没有执行？

body:
## 操作任务
实现diagnose(probe)，依次且各一次调用probe("vdso"/"libc"/"syscall")，原样保留实际报告为paths，返回{paths,absence_proves_no_execution:False}。报告completed_calls是子进程实际完成计数，clock_gettime_syscalls是父进程真实ptrace观察到的clock_gettime陷入次数，两者不能混淆；若完成计数≤0或monotonic_samples_valid不真则ValueError。固定x86_64教学程序分别经真实vDSO入口、libc及直接syscall完成500次单调计时，入口地址须在[vdso]映射中。不能把0陷入改写成0调用、伪造probe或以追踪工具没看见来推导代码没执行。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实x86_64 Linux vDSO映射、glibc、clock_gettime syscall及只追踪自有子进程的最小ptrace计数器；不安装或伪称运行strace，不提权/改ptrace策略/跟踪其他进程。现有镜像无strace，原生观察其相同的内核陷入边界；只证明当前平台这三条路径，不泛化所有clockid/架构/回退路径或给出性能优势结论。

import os,sys,pathlib,tempfile,subprocess,json,copy,platform
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());import task
if platform.machine()!='x86_64':raise RuntimeError('NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: own-child tracer requires x86_64')
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-vdso-observe-') as directory:
 binary=pathlib.Path(directory)/'clock-trace'
 built=subprocess.run(['gcc','-O0','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror','checks/clock_trace.c','-ldl','-o',str(binary)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=6);assert built.returncode==0,built.stderr
 calls=[];raw={}
 def probe(mode):
  assert mode in ('vdso','libc','syscall') and mode not in raw,'exact three owned-child modes required'
  completed=subprocess.run([str(binary),mode],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
  assert completed.returncode==0,'NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: own-child ptrace/vDSO probe unavailable: '+completed.stderr
  row=json.loads(completed.stdout);calls.append(mode);raw[mode]=copy.deepcopy(row);return row
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:separate_actual_user_calls_from_observed_kernel_traps',flush=True)
 try:result=task.diagnose(probe)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student vDSO observation diagnosis failed') from error
 assert calls==['vdso','libc','syscall'] and result=={'paths':raw,'absence_proves_no_execution':False},'syscall absence was misreported as function nonexecution or original evidence was overwritten'
 assert all(row['completed_calls']==500 and row['monotonic_samples_valid'] and row['vdso_symbol_in_vdso_mapping'] for row in raw.values())
 assert raw['vdso']['clock_gettime_syscalls']==0 and raw['libc']['clock_gettime_syscalls']==0 and raw['syscall']['clock_gettime_syscalls']==500
 print('NATIVE_VDSO_AND_LIBC_500_COMPLETED_CALLS_ZERO_CLOCK_TRAPS_DIRECT_SYSCALL_500_TRAPS',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
